card.name: Words before a role like official or volunteer
card.fires_on: Small words and modifiers just before a person-role noun such as official, volunteer, staff, president or advisor, mostly in sign-up and staffing text.

modes.label: Sign-up for a role
modes.description: Words like as, a, or and competition right before the role being filled.
modes.example: You may sign up as<< a>> competition official or as a general volunteer.

modes.label: Staffing or leadership phrases
modes.description: Linking words before a person who serves a function, such as staff, volunteers or advisors.
modes.example: At the minimum, this responsibility includes hiring<< enough>> staff to supervise the students on the premises
